_comment: Site-wide pop-up. mode 'acknowledge' shows it each visit until the visitor clicks “Don't show this again”; closing with X or Esc dismisses for that session only. Change 'id' for a NEW message so people who acknowledged the last one see the new one. Other modes: 'once' (a single time ever), 'untilDate' (with endDate), 'always'.
title: Welcome to the New Big North Site
body: Browse every school's schedule, follow standings, and watch BNC Vision — all season long.
